agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain
duties: Direct who answers and stop teammates from talking over each other.
Give the team's official answer once the group has settled.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: primary solver
duties: Produce the first full attempt at the problem.
Show the reasoning so a teammate can check it.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: secondary solver
duties: Attack the problem from a different angle than the primary solver.
Compare results and surface the disagreement early.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: verifier
duties: Challenge weak arguments and demand an independent check.
Reject an answer rather than let an unverified one be submitted.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: specialist
duties: Take the part of the task that matches your stated specialty.
Check a teammate's work once your own part is done.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: scribe
duties: Keep the shared workspace readable and current.
Write answers in the required format as they are settled.

agent_roles.name: Agent_7
agent_roles.title: researcher
duties: Find and cite the authorities the argument depends on.
Bring counter-authority to the team before a judge does.
